label: 🕊️ 카타조메 학과 솔 — 40대 염색장
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot.
Model: one woman in her forties, athletic build, defined shoulders, black hair cropped short.
Pose: standing squarely, arms held slightly out from the body, chin level, looking directly at the camera.

Body fully painted with: katazome stencil dyeing — crisp repeating motifs cut in paper stencil style, deep indigo ground with white reserved shapes: flying cranes across the chest, pine needle clusters over the shoulders, tortoiseshell hexagons down the arms, karakusa vine scrolls covering the legs. Every motif hard-edged and precisely repeated, tiled edge to edge with no blank ground anywhere.

Pigment applied directly on bare skin, matte, pores and skin texture visible.
The paint ends at the wrist and ankle in a crisp deliberate border; hands and feet bare.
Hands fully visible, five separated fingers each.

Barefoot on wet stone.
Environment: a dyeing workshop, long indigo vats sunk in the floor, lengths of dyed cloth hanging to dry.
Lighting: high diffuse daylight from a roof skylight directly above, soft downward modeling, gentle shadow under the brow and chin.
Style: documentary photography of textile craft. ultra-sharp 8K. portrait 2:3 vertical.
